subject: general
question: On 5th August 2021 which one of the following state launched 'Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam' Scheme that helps the poor, sick who can't visit hospitals and the chronically ill, by providing medical facilities at their doorstep?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

 
• The 'Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam' (which translates to "Medicine in search of the people") scheme is a flagship healthcare initiative of the Tamil Nadu government.
 
• It was launched by Chief Minister M.K. Stalin on August 5, 2021.
 
• The scheme aims to provide healthcare services at the doorsteps of people who are unable to visit hospitals.
 
• This includes individuals who are poor, sick, chronically ill, or have disabilities that restrict their mobility.
 
• The initiative focuses on providing essential medical care to those who are most in need and often lack access to healthcare facilities.
 
• Under the scheme, mobile medical teams consisting of doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals visit designated areas.
 
• These teams conduct health check-ups, provide treatment for common ailments, and dispense necessary medications.
 
• The scheme also focuses on early detection and management of chronic diseases.
 
• It aims to reduce the burden on hospitals and improve access to primary healthcare in remote and underserved areas.
 
• The 'Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam' scheme is a significant step towards strengthening primary healthcare infrastructure in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It utilizes a proactive approach to healthcare delivery, reaching out to individuals rather than waiting for them to come to hospitals.
 
• The scheme has been praised for its focus on accessibility and equity in healthcare.
 
• It has made a significant impact on the lives of many people, particularly those in rural and marginalized communities.
